question.wording: Was this expense reimbursed, or paid by insurance, an HSA or MSA distribution, or anyone else?

options.label: Yes — reimbursed or paid by others
No — paid by the taxpayer and not reimbursed

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Was this expense reimbursed, or paid by insurance, an HSA or MSA distribution, or anyone else?

citation.wording: If you received a reimbursement in 2025 for medical or dental expenses you paid in 2025, reduce your 2025 expenses by this amount.
